clinical_intent: I need to understand how cone-beam CT (CBCT) can be used for brachytherapy guidance. What are the advantages of CBCT over conventional CT for brachytherapy? How does CBCT image quality compare to CT for applicator and target visualization? What are the radiation dose implications of using CBCT for brachytherapy guidance? Should I use CBCT routinely for brachytherapy fraction imaging?
